title: TITICACA LAKE & FLOATING ISLANDS
description: Discover the Uros and Taquile culture on Lake Titicaca, the highest navigable lake in the world. Experience a unique cultural journey on the totora floating islands.
shortItinerary: Day 2: Taquile Island - Return to Puno

itinerary.title: Uros Floating Islands
itinerary.description: Boat from Puno harbor to the Uros totora floating islands. We'll learn about their ancestral way of life and build our own island.

itinerary.title: Taquile Island
itinerary.description: Visit to Taquile Island, known for its UNESCO award-winning textiles. Walk through the village and lunch with lake views. Return to Puno in the afternoon.

recommendations: Comfortable footwear for walking on islands
